Billing setup

Choose how you'd like to pay for services on Keylr.

A payment card is required to activate your account
Once your account is approved, you will be asked to add a payment card. This is used for Pay Upfront jobs and any payments made before your billing cycle is activated.
Fortnightly and Monthly billing require approval
If you select Fortnightly or Monthly billing, Keylr will review your account and contact you to set up your Direct Debit mandate. Until your billing cycle is approved and activated, you can continue using Pay Upfront.
What's your preferred billing cycle?
Pay Upfront
Default · Available Immediately
Pay for each job using your card when payment is required. Your payment is held securely in escrow and released to the supplier once the job is completed.
Fortnightly
Approval required
Receive a consolidated statement every 2 weeks for your completed and payable jobs. Payments are collected by Direct Debit once your billing cycle and mandate have been approved and activated by Keylr.
Monthly (4 weeks)
Approval required
Receive a consolidated statement every 4 weeks for your completed and payable jobs. Payments are collected by Direct Debit once your billing cycle and mandate have been approved and activated by Keylr.
About Supplier Deposits
Some suppliers may require a deposit before starting certain jobs. If required, Keylr will show the deposit amount before you confirm the job. You can pay the deposit upfront, with the remaining amount handled according to your selected billing cycle.
Billing Cycle Approval Process
1
Select your preferred billing cycle
Your selected billing cycle is recorded when you submit your profile.
2
Keylr reviews your account
A member of the Keylr team will contact you to complete the billing setup.
3
Set up your Direct Debit mandate
For Fortnightly or Monthly billing, your Direct Debit mandate must be completed and approved before the billing cycle can be activated.
4
Billing cycle is activated
Once approved, your selected billing cycle becomes active and payments are collected according to that cycle.
5
Until approval
You can continue booking and paying for services using Pay Upfront while your billing cycle approval is in progress.
You approve every job before it starts.
All charges are shown clearly before you confirm a job, regardless of your selected billing cycle.
